title: fix: keep accessibility navigation within the correct chat pane
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes Chat and tool tabs pointing assistive technology at the wrong content after swapping panels or opening the same conversation in split panes.

## User Impact

Each tab identifies its own named content region in its own pane. Swapping Chat and Tasks preserves the association and live content. Closing a tab keeps keyboard focus in the correct tab group.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared side-panel container excluded Chat and reused the same ID across panes. The existing pane presentation identity now scopes stable Chat/tool regions and tab IDs. Tabs target their actual region instead of the shared container; layout and live iframe roots stay in place. Existing tab-strip callers with one shared content target retain their behavior.

## Evidence

Candidate `4ba22c946d08629268d727cb8e9b63f54f946279` integrates main `6e70aff092768801e539fb8f5af34055ec51e6ba`. The candidate preserves the exact added/deleted lines of the reviewed accessibility patch while retaining main’s current tab measurement and sidebar geometry lifecycle. Prior independent P0–P2 review remains applicable; current owner inspection found no additional actionable finding.

The integrated candidate passed 96 owner unit cases and four real-browser focus cases in 8.899 seconds wall. The two full-app pane/layout cases and all nine group-defaults cases passed together in 21.940 seconds wall, including the 7.53-second UI build. These full-app cases protect actual cross-pane tab targets, retained content roots, geometry, iframe state, and drafts. They require the rendered application; no screen-reader execution is claimed.

Production UI types passed in 34.354 seconds, all four current UI test graphs in 165.813 seconds, scoped typed lint in 30.233 seconds, styles in 0.601 seconds, catalog verification in 2.534 seconds, and exact-page MDX validation in 0.341 seconds. Scoped formatting and candidate diff whitespace checks passed. No new documentation links were introduced. The prior broad selected-check proof remains recorded separately; the full repository suite and all core test compiler graphs were not rerun on this integration.

The earlier real-profile Chrome reproduction and candidate UI proof remain retained: Chat and Tasks each target exactly one region within their own pane after swapping; opening the same conversation twice produces distinct targets; swapping the second pane preserves the first pane’s target. That proof used the existing task Gateway backend with its matching UI protocol contract and was not repeated for this mechanical integration.

### Per-file cost

Each changed test file passed separately through the supported `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs <file> --maxWorkers=1` wrapper, using Node 24.20.0 and Chromium 153 where applicable. These are complete process wall times, including startup and any UI build. The worker flag was used only for measurement and adds no test/config pin.

| File | Cases | One-worker wall |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `ui/src/components/panel-tab-strip.browser.test.ts` | 4 | 2.072s |
| `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-pane-sidebar-layout.lazy.test.ts` | 1 | 4.410s |
| `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-pane-sidebar-layout.test.ts` | 16 | 4.508s |
| `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-sidebar-region-hosted-tabs.test.ts` | 13 | 4.621s |
| `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-sidebar-region.test.ts` | 28 | 6.892s |
| `ui/src/e2e/task-panel-layout.e2e.test.ts` | 2 | 22.055s |

The full-app file reported 9.707 seconds of file time within its 22.055-second process wall time. It verifies cross-pane accessible targets plus retained iframe/draft state and saved geometry across docking and narrow layouts. Isolated owner tests cannot establish those browser/layout contracts. No new sleeps, retries, timeout increases, or assertion weakening were added.

All six changed files passed on the published head in CI run 35593059301. [Exact-head hosted timings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/153478#issuecomment-5759741003) record 0.221s, 0.079s, 0.660s, 1.547s, 2.364s, and 19.654s respectively. These are module/file durations, separate from the local process wall times above; they exclude shared-job startup and are not marginal CI cost estimates. Overall CI completion remains subject to the normal merge gate.

### Historical CI failure and limits

CI run 35537823675, job 106150035145, found zero descendants for the New worktree role locator in the first group-defaults case at line 133. Its cause remains unexplained: zero does not establish whether the control was missing, hidden/inert, incorrectly labelled, or missing its icon. The exact historical merge’s original 50-file/310-case shard replay passed in 590.874 seconds with observation instrumentation. That is nonreproduction, not proof of a fix. A separate controlled folder-hide/menu-open overlap also passed with matching Chromium153.

Main includes the dropdown opening/focus owner repair in #154285 and tab/sidebar lifecycle changes in #154179. Those are legitimate integration inputs, but neither is claimed to explain the historical failure. On this integrated candidate the formerly failing flow passed in 2.416 seconds with existing failure-only diagnostics; those diagnostics did not run, and the temporary capture wrapper was removed afterward. Assertions, timeouts, and production behavior were not weakened. The old whole shard was not rerun. Final exact-head CI remains required.

### Visual evidence

The inspected synthetic before/after captures below were already delivered in chat and attached here. They show the same two-pane setup; appearance intentionally stays unchanged. The integrated patch preserves the same accessibility associations, and fresh DOM assertions prove them. No new screenshots are claimed for this integration.

![Before: synthetic split panes with duplicate and incorrect accessibility targets](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/58f5a037-cb8b-4636-8479-cba9e4492298)

![After: same layout with content targets scoped to each pane](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f3ec7f26-1961-4199-81bd-8844415cb235)
